headline: Doctor Doom's Classic Origin and Comic History
post:
Did you know that the iconic supervillain Doctor Doom first appeared in The Fantastic Four #5 back in July 1962, created by writer-editor Stan Lee and artist Jack Kirby? In the comics, he is the monarch of Latveria and a master of both science and sorcery, serving as the ultimate archenemy to Mister Fantastic and the Fantastic Four.

headline: Benedict Cumberbatch adjusted schedule for Doctor Strange
post:
Benedict Cumberbatch was chosen for the eponymous role in Doctor Strange in December 2014, necessitating a schedule change to work around his other commitments. This gave director Scott Derrickson time to work on the script himself, for which he brought C. Robert Cargill on to help.

Principal photography began in November 2015 in Nepal, before moving to England and wrapping up in New York City in April 2016. The film later grossed $677.8 million worldwide.
